lines.text:
You awake slowly on a cold tile floor. the muffled wailing of alarms echo through your ears. Your vision slowly focuses and you glance around at your surroundings, desperately trying to understand where you are.
		But when you reach for your memories, theres just a void, an appalling nothingness.
Ugh, I should try and get out of here... Am i missing anything? (Press I to check your inventory)
Finally, I'm not sure if this is me, but it'll work, time to move on.
A Researcher ID. Is this me? The name field seems to have been charred off.
Level-2 keycard. Still strangely warm, like someone left in a hurry.
There's nothing else in here save for some pens and clips.
Nothing interesting is left in the locker.
Security door. I'll need a keycard to get through.
The badge reader demands a registered name before it will clear Me. I'll need to provide some form of identification first.
The reader chirps. The door unlatches into the east corridor.
Rows of redacted entries. Someone circled a date—yesterday.
Papers coat the floor like snow. You have the eerie feeling that you're being watched, hairs prickle upon the back of your neck.
Cafeteria memo: all break-room microwaves replaced. Mundane. Almost reassuring, there was human activity here recently.
You've already read this memo.
Incident follow-up—Subject interaction logged. Appendix pages torn out. [REDACTED] exhibited strange, familial traits towards the scientists today.
You've barely started the next line before you feel the cold chill of something coiling it's way around your neck.
Scorch marks on the floor. Whatever was here left in a hurry.
Personnel roster. Every name blacked out except one—unreadable, but familiar.
Only ash remains.
The archives feel safer than the corridor.
A shape at the edge of vision. It studies you—measuring friend or threat.

choices.text: Offer the notes you picked up from other papers.

lines.text: It stills. For now, you think it understands.
It bristles. You'll hear from it again—and not kindly.
